'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
